'''''Cylindropuntia tunicata''''', commonly referred to as '''sheathed cholla''', is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Cactaceae]].<ref name=POWO>{{cite web |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:73905-2 |title= Cylindropuntia tunicata (Lehm.) F.M.Knuth |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=June 16, 2025}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{cite web |url= https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/333W9 |title= Cylindropuntia tunicata (Lehm.) F.M.Knuth |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Catalogue of Life |publisher=Species 2000 |access-date=June 16, 2025}}</ref> This [[Cylindropuntia|cholla]] species is native to the [[Chihuahuan Desert]] of North America and parts of South America.<ref>{{citation |chapter-url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242415152 |title=Flora of North America |chapter=''Cylindropuntia tunicata'' (Lehmann) F. M. Knuth in C. Backeberg and F. M. Knuth, Kaktus-ABC. 126. 1935 |author=Donald J. Pinkava}}</ref> Is also known as '''Brown-spined Hudson pear'''.<ref name="weeds.dpi.nsw.gov.au">[https://weeds.dpi.nsw.gov.au/Weeds/BrownSpinedHudsonPear Brown-spined Hudson pear (Cylindropuntia tunicata)]</ref>

==Distribution==
===As an agricultural weed===
''C. tunicata'' is an invasive species affecting agriculture in [[Queensland]], [[Australia]].<ref name="Queensland" /> It has spines up to 7 cm long that cause painful injuries to people, livestock, working dogs, pets and damage tyres on vehicles.<ref name="weeds.dpi.nsw.gov.au"/>
